---
title: "p2 Data: extracting and cleaning shots"
---

Gets the shots out of the raw events (from p1) and cleans them.

Makes (all in data/):

- key_passes_raw.rds: the pass that set up each shot (for assist type and the key pass features)
- extra_events.rds: footedness, own goals, substitutions and possession start times (for p3)
- shots_comp_info.rds: every shot with its competition info (EDA and p3)
- shots_cleaned.rds: men's shots, no penalties, StatsBombR features added (EDA)
- shots_final.rds: the open play shots used for modelling (EDA and p3)

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(StatsBombR)
library(here)
here::i_am("_pipeline/p2_data.qmd")
```

# Shots and the events they need

```{r}
competition_event_files <- list.files(here("data", "raw_events"), full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(competition_event_files) > 0) # stop if p1 hasn't been run

shots_list <- list()
key_passes_list <- list()
passes_list <- list()
own_goals_list <- list()
subs_list <- list()
poss_start_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(competition_event_files)) {
  events <- readRDS(competition_event_files[i])
  shot_events <- events |> filter(type.name == "Shot")

  shots_list[[i]] <- shot_events

  key_passes_list[[i]] <- events |>
    filter(id %in% shot_events$shot.key_pass_id) |>
    select(id, any_of("location"), starts_with("pass."))

  # every pass, for footedness
  passes_list[[i]] <- events |>
    filter(type.name == "Pass") |>
    select(any_of(c("player.id", "pass.body_part.name")))

  # own goals, for goal_diff
  own_goals_list[[i]] <- events |>
    filter(type.name == "Own Goal For") |>
    select(any_of(c("match_id", "index", "team.name")))

  # who came on when, for time on pitch
  subs_list[[i]] <- events |>
    filter(type.name == "Substitution") |>
    select(match_id, sub_minute = minute, any_of(c(player.id = "substitution.replacement.id")))

  # when each possession started, in seconds
  poss_start_list[[i]] <- events |>
    group_by(match_id, possession) |>
    summarise(poss_start = min(minute * 60 + second), .groups = "drop")
}

shots <- bind_rows(shots_list) |> select(where(\(x) !all(is.na(x))))
key_passes <- bind_rows(key_passes_list) |> select(where(\(x) !all(is.na(x))))

extra <- list(footedness = get.playerfootedness(bind_rows(passes_list)),
              own_goals = bind_rows(own_goals_list),
              subs = bind_rows(subs_list),
              poss_start = bind_rows(poss_start_list))

saveRDS(key_passes, here("data", "key_passes_raw.rds"))
saveRDS(extra, here("data", "extra_events.rds"))

print(sum(!is.na(shots$shot.key_pass_id)) - nrow(key_passes)) # key passes not found, should be 0

rm(events, shot_events, shots_list, key_passes_list, passes_list, own_goals_list, subs_list,
   poss_start_list, key_passes, extra, competition_event_files, i)
```

# Competition info

```{r}
load(here("data", "Comp_Match_Data.RData"))

num_shots_before <- nrow(shots)
shots <- shots |> left_join(Comp |> select(-starts_with("match_")), by = c("competition_id", "season_id"))
print(nrow(shots) - num_shots_before) # must be 0
print(sum(is.na(shots$competition_name))) # must be 0

saveRDS(shots, here("data", "shots_comp_info.rds"))
rm(num_shots_before, Comp, Matches)
```

# Cleaning

Men's shots, no penalties, then StatsBombR's cleaning and feature functions.

```{r}
shots <- shots |>
  filter(shot.type.name != "Penalty", competition_gender == "male") |>
  cleanlocations() |>
  goalkeeperinfo() |>
  shotinfo() |>
  freezeframeinfo() |>
  mutate(goal = shot.outcome.name == "Goal",
         season_start = as.integer(substr(season_name, 1, 4)),
         ff_players = map_int(shot.freeze_frame, NROW),
         off_cam = !is.na(off_camera))

# no player names anywhere
shots <- shots |>
  select(-contains("player.name")) |>
  mutate(shot.freeze_frame = map(shot.freeze_frame,
                                 \(ff) if (is.null(ff)) ff else select(ff, -any_of("player.name"))))

saveRDS(shots, here("data", "shots_cleaned.rds"))
```

# Final shots for modelling

Open play only (removes corners and direct free kicks), on camera, with a goalkeeper in the freeze frame.

```{r}
num_shots_before <- nrow(shots)
shots <- shots |>
  filter(shot.type.name == "Open Play", !off_cam, !is.na(location.x.GK))
print(num_shots_before - nrow(shots)) # shots removed

shots <- shots |>
  select(-c(location, shot.end_location, pass.end_location, carry.end_location,
            goalkeeper.end_location, tactics.lineup,
            pass.end_location.x, pass.end_location.y,
            carry.end_location.x, carry.end_location.y,
            type.id, type.name, play_pattern.id, position.id,
            shot.type.id, shot.outcome.id, shot.technique.id, shot.body_part.id)) |>
  mutate(across(c(under_pressure, shot.first_time, shot.one_on_one,
                  shot.open_goal, shot.aerial_won, shot.follows_dribble),
                \(x) replace_na(x, FALSE)))

print(nrow(shots) == n_distinct(shots$id)) # must be TRUE

saveRDS(shots, here("data", "shots_final.rds"))
```
